description: Copy SOURCE to DEST, or multiple SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

option.name: --archive
tip: Same as -dR --preserve=all

option.name: --attributes-only
tip: Don't copy the file data, just the attributes

option.name: --backup
tip: make a backup of each existing destination file

option.name: --context
tip: like -Z, or if CTX is specified then set the SELinux or SMACK security context to CTX

option.name: --copy-contents
tip: NotImplemented: copy contents of special files when recursive

option.name: --debug
tip: explain how a file is copied. Implies -v

option.name: --dereference
tip: always follow symbolic links in SOURCE

option.name: --force
tip: if an existing destination file cannot be opened, remove it and try again (this option is ignored when the -n option is also used). Currently not implemented for Windows

option.name: --interactive
tip: ask before overwriting files

option.name: --link
tip: hard-link files instead of copying

option.name: --no-clobber
tip: don't overwrite a file that already exists

option.name: --no-dereference
tip: never follow symbolic links in SOURCE

option.name: --no-preserve
tip: don't preserve the specified attributes

option.name: --no-target-directory
tip: Treat DEST as a regular file and not a directory

option.name: --one-file-system
tip: stay on this file system

option.name: --parents
tip: use full source file name under DIRECTORY

option.name: --preserve
tip: Preserve the specified attributes (default: mode, ownership (unix only), timestamps), if possible additional attributes: context, links, xattr, all

option.name: --preserve-default-attributes
tip: same as --preserve=mode,ownership(unix only),timestamps

option.name: --progress
tip: Display a progress bar. Note: this feature is not supported by GNU coreutils

option.name: --recursive
tip: copy directories recursively

option.name: --reflink
tip: control clone/CoW copies. See below

option.name: --remove-destination
tip: remove each existing destination file before attempting to open it (contrast with --force). On Windows, currently only works for writeable files

option.name: --sparse
tip: control creation of sparse files. See below

option.name: --strip-trailing-slashes
tip: remove any trailing slashes from each SOURCE argument

option.name: --suffix
tip: override the usual backup suffix

option.name: --symbolic-link
tip: make symbolic links instead of copying

option.name: --target-directory
tip: copy all SOURCE arguments into target-directory

option.name: --update
tip: move only when the SOURCE file is newer than the destination file or when the destination file is missing

option.name: --verbose
tip: explicitly state what is being done

option.name: --version
tip: Print version

option.name: -b
tip: like --backup but does not accept an argument

option.name: -d
tip: same as --no-dereference --preserve=links

option.name: -H
tip: follow command-line symbolic links in SOURCE

option.name: -u
tip: like --update but does not accept an argument

option.name: -Z
tip: set SELinux security context of destination file to default type

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print help
